scope: Private per-candidate deformable narrowphase failure records plus ascending-slot reducer, with native checker controls that dispatch the production geometric failure producer in private and ordinary modes.
selection_contract: For selector 1, producer records the failure in the candidate slot and leaves environment status unchanged until the reducer; reducer chooses the lowest failed candidate slot within the active prefix while preserving earlier environment failure. Selector 0 retains ordinary first-writer environment status behavior.
cmake: No CMake changes. Existing target matter/tools/cardboard_contact_ccd_native_check.mm is already registered as numi-matter-cardboard-contact-ccd-native-check / matter.metal.cardboard_contact_ccd_native.

geometric_failure_control.path: Production nm_contact_narrowphase_deformable point-point branch -> pointPointCCD -> uncertified result -> recordDeformableNarrowphaseFailure.
geometric_failure_control.authored_inputs: One active point-point candidate, positions (+1e20,-1e20), candidate velocities (-2e20,+2e20), dt=1, thickness=1e-3; all authored float inputs are finite.
geometric_failure_control.failure_mechanism: Finite FP32 relative position/velocity squared terms overflow; discriminant/time/distance become non-finite and pointPointCCD returns uncertified. This is an artificial status-routing witness, not a physical contact specimen.
geometric_failure_control.private_expected: Candidate tuple CONTACT_FAILURE, object 0, slot 0, diagnostics [0,1,0,0]; environment remains byte-identical success before reduction; reducer then propagates the tuple and preserves counters.
geometric_failure_control.ordinary_expected: With selector 0 the same tuple is written to environment status; candidate-status sentinel remains byte-identical.

memory.native_checker_fixture: single environment, one candidate slot; fixed buffers only

test_coverage.producer_clear: Production narrowphase selector 1 clears stale private status slots and preserves healthy environment statuses.
test_coverage.geometric_producer: Production point-point failure branch exercised by a finite-input overflow control in selector 1 and selector 0; status tuple and routing checked, then private tuple is reduced.
test_coverage.reducer: Multi-environment producer/reducer controls cover minimum slot, earlier phase status, empty active prefix, healthy prefix, stale tail, and counter preservation.
test_coverage.physics_scope: Status routing only. No physically meaningful contact or full simulation qualification.
